//go:build kubeapiserver

// Copied into stackstate-agent pkg/util/kubernetes/apiserver by generate.sh, so
// that the KSM check's buildStores gets a fake clientset from GetAPIClient.
package apiserver

import (
	"k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes"

	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/pkg/util/retry"
)

// SetGoldenAPIClient makes GetAPIClient return a client backed by cl.
func SetGoldenAPIClient(cl kubernetes.Interface) error {
	globalAPIClientOnce.Do(initAPIClient)
	globalAPIClient.Cl = cl
	globalAPIClient.InformerCl = cl
	if err := globalAPIClient.initRetry.SetupRetrier(&retry.Config{
		Name:          "golden-apiserver",
		AttemptMethod: func() error { return nil },
		Strategy:      retry.JustTesting,
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := globalAPIClient.initRetry.TriggerRetry(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
